material_findings: A cursor that advances to the latest successful Mission View projection can leapfrog an earlier swallowed projection failure and permanently seal a canonical event hole.
The required progress contract is the highest contiguous projected prefix; later projections must catch up an earlier gap before advancing view/cursor state.
Current Argus event_id/id helpers are not a canonical unique event-log identity; a reserved sink-owned event_log_id is the safer cursor basis.
Marten July-2026 discussion #4953 and its regression/fix provide independent evidence for holding projection progress before an unresolved gap rather than silently advancing across it.

Current Argus source does not establish power-loss durability for canonical events.jsonl because explicit append/rotation fsync ordering is absent; candidate scope remains process-restart/projection-exception consistency.
